        or "maximum clique" in text
        or "maximum flow" in text
        or "chord" in text
        or "dht" in text
        or "nmap" in text
        or "def " in text
        or "return " in text
        or "output of the code" in text
        or "prints" in text
        or "print(" in text
        or "output?" in q
        or "time complexity" in q
    ):
        return "defer"

    # The only trivial nano cases: short, obvious definition/abbreviation
    if (
        len(q) < 100
        and (
            q.startswith("what is")
            or q.startswith("what are")
            or q.startswith("define")
            or q.startswith("the definition of")
            or "stands for" in q
            or "abbreviation" in q
        )
    ):

    # Additional safe pattern: "What does [X] stand for?"
    if (
        len(q) < 100
        and q.startswith("what does")
        and "stand for" in q
    ):
